record.question: Name the Gujarat Governor who was transferred to Mizoram as Governor for the rest of his/her tenure:
record.explanation: Answer B: Kamla Beniwal. Kamla Beniwal was transferred from Gujarat to Mizoram in July 2014. The original parliamentary constitutional chronicle records the transfer on 6 July; Mizoram's governor archive records her tenure from 9 July to 6 August 2014. The rest-of-tenure phrase describes the appointment's terms, not its eventual duration. Historical/source note: Historical transfer; she actually served less than a month in Mizoram. Reference: https://sansad.in/uploads/JPI_Dec_2014_E_faad745490.pdf?updated_at=2022-09-14T06%3A15%3A59.898Z; https://rajbhavan.mizoram.gov.in/previous-governors/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
